hook.text: The average American has 12 active subscriptions costing $219/month. Many don't realize this.

buildup.text: Each subscription feels small individually. Together they create a silent drain on monthly budgets.

discovery.text: Apps like Truebill found that users had forgotten about 40% of their active subscriptions.

twist.text: Subscription fatigue is growing. 27% of US consumers canceled a subscription in the past month.

climax.text: Companies now compete not just against alternatives but against the 'cancel everything' impulse.

quiz.question: What percentage of subscriptions do users typically forget about?
